studyMetadata.title: Templating Data with Handlebars
studyMetadata.description: A demo of using Handlebars {{variable}} templating (and the lookupAnswersRel/lookupAnswers helpers for referencing other trials' answers) in instructions, paths, markdown/help-text content, response text, and templated website HTML files, and correctAnswer values, showcased through a two-question capital-cities quiz.

markdown-template-quiz.instruction: Which city is the capital of {{country}}?{{#if (lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer')}} (Last time, you answered "{{lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer'}}".){{/if}}

response.infoText: This trial's parameters: country={{country}}, continent={{continent}}, hintFile={{hintFile}}, funFact={{funFact}}, flag={{flag}}.{{#if (lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer')}} Previous answer: {{lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer'}}.{{/if}}

html-template-quiz.instruction:
Which city is the capital of {{country}}?{{#if (lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer')}} (Last time, you answered "{{lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer'}}".){{/if}}

*Select your answer from the options on your right.*
html-template-quiz.description: Templated HTML stimulus: the parameters are substituted into the file itself.

response.infoText: This trial's parameters: country={{country}}, continent={{continent}}, funFact={{funFact}}, cityOptions={{cityOptions}}, flag={{flag}}.{{#if (lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer')}} Previous answer: {{lookupAnswersRel -1 'capital-answer'}}.{{/if}}
